label: State-funded places through LAMA BPO, autumn 2027

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Before the main round closes, if 2027 follows 2026.

milestones.label: Main admission closes
milestones.note: In 2026: 23 July at 12:00, with offers on 30 July and contracts signed in person by 1 August. Two short additional rounds followed in August.

supplementarySteps: For EU and EFTA citizens only, and only for state-funded places. For a fee-paying place, apply to the university directly.
Upload the IB Diploma as it is — LAMA BPO says IB grades need no conversion.
English-taught Medicine and Dentistry are not state-funded; they go through the university's own procedure.

notes: Not established: which English-taught programmes outside Vilnius University offer state-funded places, how many choices LAMA BPO allows, and how the competitive score is built from IB grades.
LAMA BPO is an association of institutions running joint admission, hence channel 'consortium'; no application-system record was created.
